description: Get the Schedule 13D and 13G stakes a named institution has disclosed: its latest filing on each listed security (13D or 13G, amendment or not) with the event and filing dates, accession, the shares (restated onto today's split basis) and percent of class, the change since the filer's previous filing on that security, a 13D's Item 4 purpose where described, and a status: current; unconfirmed (no filing in 24 months; a 13D or 13G stays in force until amended, so the stake is kept and never assumed sold); below 5% (the final amendment that ends the filer's duty to amend, not necessarily the holding); exited (no shares); or security retired (the issuer no longer trades in the US). Current and unconfirmed stakes list by default; includeHistory adds the rest. These are event-dated 5% stakes, not a quarter-end portfolio: GetInstitutionPortfolio covers the 13F book. Resolve exact CIKs with SearchInstitutions; a filer that files only 13D or 13G resolves too.

includeHistory.description: Also list stakes reported below 5%, exited, or on securities that no longer trade (default: false)

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stakes to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of stakes to skip before returning results (default: 0)

name: GetInstitutionBeneficialOwnership
title: Institution 13D and 13G Stakes
